tooltip.radiologistics.wired_inertia_fuz:
Acts as an impact-detonated fuze.
- Can be inserted into big cannon shells.
- When the shell block is powered by redstone, it will launch the projectile in the facing direction without exploding on the spot.
tooltip.radiologistics.main_computer:
Central processing unit of your network.
§6Nodes: §rAll basic math, logic, text, and variables.
- Right-click to open node programming GUI.
tooltip.radiologistics.radio_transmitter:
Broadcasts wireless messages on redstone power.
- Right-click to edit Channel and Message.
- Target with §eAntenna§7 to link and boost range.
tooltip.radiologistics.redstone_link_mod:
Interfaces external redstone links with the network.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Link Input: §7Reads signals from wireless redstone channels.
§e- Link Output: §7Sends wireless signals to redstone channels.
tooltip.radiologistics.memory_module:
Saves and retrieves network variables persistently.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Variable: §7Reads stored values from memory database.
§e- Set Variable: §7Writes new values to memory database.
tooltip.radiologistics.gyroscope_sensor:
Measures orientation and position.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Gyroscope: §7Reads Pitch and Yaw angles.
§e- Gyroscope Position: §7Reads absolute coordinate positions.
tooltip.radiologistics.antenna:
Increases transmitter and receiver range.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Antenna Input: §7Receives signals on radio channels.
§e- Antenna Output: §7Broadcasts signals to radio channels.
- Target transmitter/computer first, then place base.
- Stack vertically (+150 blocks range per segment).
tooltip.radiologistics.jammer:
Disrupts radio communications in specified ranges.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Jammer: §7Jams a configurable range of channels when active.
tooltip.radiologistics.audio_module:
Plays audio and text-to-speech wirelessly.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Audio Play: §7Plays any audio stream piped into it.
§e- Link Stream: §7Builds an audio stream from a URL (WAV/MP3/YouTube).
§e- Text Stream: §7Builds a TTS stream from text.
§e- Microphone: §7Captures nearby players' voice chat.
The Radio Transmitter broadcasts wireless signals when powered by redstone.
Right-click it to configure the channel (0-255) and transmission message.
First, right-click the transmitter with the antenna in hand to target it.
Then place the antenna. It will connect to the targeted transmitter.
Stacking multiple antenna segments vertically sums their height to boost transmission range.
radiologistics.ponder.network_scene.head: Computer Network Setup
radiologistics.ponder.network_scene.text: First, place the Main Computer. It is the CPU of your network.
Right-click the computer with the module in hand to set it as a target.
Then place the module block. It will connect to the targeted computer.
You can also connect a Display Link and a Network Controller from Create Radars

radiologistics.node_ponder.hold_w: Hold W to learn about this node
radiologistics.node_ponder.signal.title: Signal
radiologistics.node_ponder.signal.desc: Reads the last broadcast value on a wireless radio channel. Connect a number or text node to set the channel.
radiologistics.node_ponder.signal.compat: Bool Viewer, If, Or, Set Variable
radiologistics.node_ponder.bool.title: Bool
radiologistics.node_ponder.bool.desc: A constant Boolean value (TRUE or FALSE). Click the button in the node to toggle the value. Use as a constant condition or a static flag.
radiologistics.node_ponder.bool.compat: If, Or, Equal, Not Equal, Set Variable, Bool Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.number.title: Number
radiologistics.node_ponder.number.desc: A constant numeric value. Click the property field to type a new value. Supports decimals and negative numbers.
radiologistics.node_ponder.number.compat: Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, Equal, Greater Than, Less Than, RS Output, Link Output, Antenna Output
radiologistics.node_ponder.text.title: Text
radiologistics.node_ponder.text.desc: A constant text string. Click the property field to edit the text. Useful for fixed labels, sound IDs, or antenna channel names.
radiologistics.node_ponder.text.compat: Text Viewer, Text Join, Text Split, Display Link, Antenna Output, Text Speak
radiologistics.node_ponder.comment.title: Comment
radiologistics.node_ponder.comment.desc: A text annotation on the canvas. Does not affect logic. Click to edit. Use to document your algorithm.
radiologistics.node_ponder.if.title: If
radiologistics.node_ponder.if.desc: Passes the value of input B through to the output only when condition A is TRUE. If the condition is FALSE, the output is suppressed (no signal).
radiologistics.node_ponder.if.compat: Bool, Signal, Or, Equal, Not Equal, Greater Than, Less Than
radiologistics.node_ponder.or.title: Or
radiologistics.node_ponder.or.desc: Logical OR of two Boolean inputs. Returns TRUE if at least one of the inputs is TRUE. Both inputs must be Bool type.
radiologistics.node_ponder.or.compat: Bool, Signal, If, Set Variable, Bool Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.equal.title: Equal
radiologistics.node_ponder.equal.desc: Compares two values for equality. Returns TRUE if both inputs are exactly equal. Works with numbers, booleans, and text.
radiologistics.node_ponder.equal.compat: If, Bool Viewer, Or, Set Variable
radiologistics.node_ponder.not_equal.des: Compares two values and returns TRUE if they are NOT equal. Opposite of Equal node.
radiologistics.node_ponder.not_equal.com: If, Bool Viewer, Or, Set Variable
Returns TRUE if input A is strictly greater than input B. Both inputs must be numeric.
If, Bool Viewer, Or, Set Variable
radiologistics.node_ponder.less_than.des: Returns TRUE if input A is strictly less than input B. Both inputs must be numeric.
radiologistics.node_ponder.less_than.com: If, Bool Viewer, Or, Set Variable
radiologistics.node_ponder.add.title: Add
radiologistics.node_ponder.add.desc: Adds two numeric inputs together (A + B). The result is output as a number.
radiologistics.node_ponder.add.compat: Number, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, Equal, Greater Than, Less Than, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.subtract.desc: Subtracts B from A (A - B). Both inputs must be numeric.
radiologistics.node_ponder.subtract.comp: Number, Add, Multiply, Divide, Equal, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.multiply.comp: Number, Add, Divide, Floor, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.divide.title: Divide
radiologistics.node_ponder.divide.desc: Divides A by B (A ÷ B). Division by zero returns 0.
radiologistics.node_ponder.divide.compat: Number, Add, Multiply, Floor, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.floor.title: Floor
radiologistics.node_ponder.floor.desc: Rounds a number down to the nearest whole integer (e.g. 3.9 → 3, -1.2 → -2).
radiologistics.node_ponder.floor.compat: Number, Divide, Sqrt, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.sqrt.title: Sqrt
radiologistics.node_ponder.sqrt.desc: Computes the square root of a number. Input must be non-negative; negative inputs return 0.
radiologistics.node_ponder.sqrt.compat: Number, Multiply, Atan2, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.square.title: Square
radiologistics.node_ponder.square.desc: Raises the input to the power of 2 (x²). Equivalent to multiplying a number by itself.
radiologistics.node_ponder.square.compat: Number, Add, Sqrt, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.atan2.title: Atan2
radiologistics.node_ponder.atan2.desc: Computes the angle (in degrees) between the positive X axis and the point (A, B). Useful for direction calculations.
radiologistics.node_ponder.atan2.compat: Number, Gyroscope, Gyro Position, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.invert.title: Invert
radiologistics.node_ponder.invert.desc: Negates a number (-x). For example, 5 becomes -5 and -3 becomes 3.
radiologistics.node_ponder.invert.compat: Number, Add, Subtract, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.abs.title: Abs
radiologistics.node_ponder.abs.desc: Returns the absolute value of a number (always non-negative). For example, -7 becomes 7.
radiologistics.node_ponder.abs.compat: Number, Add, Subtract, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.sin.title: Sin
radiologistics.node_ponder.sin.desc: Computes the sine of the input angle in degrees. Returns a value between -1 and 1.
radiologistics.node_ponder.sin.compat: Number, Gyroscope, Multiply, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.cos.title: Cos
radiologistics.node_ponder.cos.desc: Computes the cosine of the input angle in degrees. Returns a value between -1 and 1.
radiologistics.node_ponder.cos.compat: Number, Gyroscope, Multiply, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.tan.title: Tan
radiologistics.node_ponder.tan.desc: Computes the tangent of the input angle in degrees.
radiologistics.node_ponder.tan.compat: Number, Gyroscope, Multiply, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.ctg.title: Ctg
radiologistics.node_ponder.ctg.desc: Computes the cotangent of the input angle in degrees (1 ÷ tan).
radiologistics.node_ponder.ctg.compat: Number, Gyroscope, Multiply, RS Output, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.redstone_outp: Emits a redstone signal from the specified face of the Main Computer block. The signal strength is proportional to the numeric input (0–15). Click to cycle the output face.
Number, Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, If
Sends text to a connected Create Display Link block. The text value is forwarded whenever the graph evaluates.
Text, Text Join, Text Speak, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.link_input.de: Reads the numeric value from a Redstone Link channel. Configure two item frequencies using the hotbar. Requires a Redstone Link Module connected to the computer.
radiologistics.node_ponder.link_input.co: Number Viewer, Add, Subtract, Equal, Greater Than, Less Than
radiologistics.node_ponder.link_output.d: Writes a numeric value to a Redstone Link channel. Configure two item frequencies using the hotbar. Requires a Redstone Link Module connected to the computer.
radiologistics.node_ponder.gyroscope.des: Reads the current Pitch and Yaw rotation angles of the contraption from the attached Gyroscope Sensor module. Outputs two numeric values in degrees.
radiologistics.node_ponder.gyroscope.com: Sin, Cos, Tan, Atan2, Number Viewer, RS Output
radiologistics.node_ponder.gyroscope_pos: Reads the absolute world X, Y, Z coordinates of the contraption from the Gyroscope Sensor. Outputs three numeric values.
Subtract, Atan2, Number Viewer, RS Output
radiologistics.node_ponder.antenna_outpu: Broadcasts a message on a radio channel when the event trigger fires. Accepts a channel number and any payload data. Requires an Antenna module.
radiologistics.node_ponder.active_target: Reads information about the currently targeted contraption from a Network Controller (Create Radars). Outputs the target's name, distance, pitch, yaw, and coordinates.
Number Viewer, Text Viewer, Subtract, Atan2, RS Output
radiologistics.node_ponder.jammer.title: Jammer
radiologistics.node_ponder.jammer.desc: Activates the Jammer module to block radio communications within a configured channel range. Only one Jammer node is allowed per computer. Requires a Jammer module.
radiologistics.node_ponder.variable.desc: Reads the current value of a named variable from memory. The variable must be defined in the VARS panel. Requires a Memory Module.
radiologistics.node_ponder.variable.comp: If, Equal, Add, Bool Viewer, Number Viewer, Text Viewer
Writes a value to a named variable in memory when the event trigger fires. The event input (Bool) controls when the write occurs. Requires a Memory Module.
radiologistics.node_ponder.bool_viewer.d: Displays the current Boolean value in the node editor GUI in real-time. Shows ACTIVE (green) or INACTIVE (red). Does not affect logic.
radiologistics.node_ponder.bool_viewer.c: Bool, Signal, If, Or, Equal, Not Equal
radiologistics.node_ponder.number_viewer: Displays the current numeric value in the node editor GUI in real-time as an amber readout. Does not affect logic.
Number, Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, Gyroscope, Link Input
radiologistics.node_ponder.text_viewer.d: Displays the current text value in the node editor GUI in real-time. Does not affect logic.
radiologistics.node_ponder.text_viewer.c: Text, Text Join, Text Split, Antenna Input
radiologistics.node_ponder.text_split.de: Splits a text string by a delimiter and returns the Nth part. Input: text string and part index number. Useful for parsing radio messages.
radiologistics.node_ponder.text_split.co: Text, Number → Text Viewer, Text Join, Display Link
radiologistics.node_ponder.text_join.des: Concatenates two text strings together into one. The second string is appended directly after the first.
radiologistics.node_ponder.text_join.com: Text, Text Split → Text Viewer, Display Link, Antenna Output
radiologistics.node_ponder.text_speak.de: Packages a text string into a TTS audio stream that an Audio Play node can consume. Connect to Audio Play's stream input to make the audio module speak text.
radiologistics.node_ponder.sound_play.de: Packages a URL and playback parameters into an audio stream that an Audio Play node can consume. Supports WAV, MP3, and YouTube links.
radiologistics.node_ponder.random.title: Random
radiologistics.node_ponder.random.desc: Generates a random decimal number between min and max inputs. If both inputs are integers, it outputs an integer.
radiologistics.node_ponder.random.compat: Number, Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, Number Viewer
radiologistics.node_ponder.degree_vector: Calculates the shortest angle difference to add to degree A to get degree B. Accounts for angular wrapping at -180 and 180 degrees.
Number, Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, Number Viewer
item.radiologistics.wired_inertia_fuze.t: Upon impact this fuze has a _%s%%_ chance to detonate.
This fuze can break through _%s_ blocks before breaking.
tooltip.radiologistics.pilot_helmet:
Protects your head and interfaces with computers.
- Right-click a Main Computer with this helmet in hand to link them.
- Provides player position and rotation node inputs to the computer when worn.
tooltip.radiologistics.wire:
Used to link display blocks directly to a Main Computer.
- Right-click a Main Computer to bind the wire, then right-click a Flap Display Board to connect it as a network node.
tooltip.radiologistics.cassette_reader:
Reads video feed from a Vista cassette to output on screens and HUD.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Cassette Reader: §7Reads cassette feed data.
tooltip.radiologistics.transparent_scree:
Renders high-tech HUD overlays and telemetry.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Screen: §7Displays visual HUD elements.
tooltip.radiologistics.helmet_linked: Linked pilot helmet to computer at %s
tooltip.radiologistics.wire_no_computer: This wire is not linked to any computer! Click a Main Computer first.
tooltip.radiologistics.wire_computer_los: The computer this wire was linked to could not be found.
tooltip.radiologistics.wire_already_conn: This display is already registered in the computer's network.
tooltip.radiologistics.wire_connected: Connected Display Board at %s to the network.
radiologistics.node_ponder.shape.title: Shape
radiologistics.node_ponder.shape.desc: A constant shape type (Rectangle, Circle, Line, Text, Point). Click the cycle button to cycle shapes.
radiologistics.node_ponder.color_rgb.des: Combines numeric R, G, B inputs (0-255) into a single color value.
radiologistics.node_ponder.cannon_rot.de: Queries current Pitch and Yaw angles of the connected Cannon Mount. Requires a wired Cannon Mount module.
radiologistics.ponder.main_computer.text: Connect a Display Board to print dynamic train-station style board info.
Or hook up a Cannon Mount from Create Big Cannons to automatically align and fire cannons.
Finally, link a Vista Camera to retrieve video streams and control its Pitch and Yaw lens rotation!

radiologistics.ponder.transparent_screen: The Transparent Screen outputs 2D/3D graphics, text, and camera feeds.
Use a Wire to connect the Screen block directly to the Main Computer.
Once linked, the computer's graph node layout will output graphics directly on the screen canvas!
radiologistics.ponder.pilot_helmet.text_: The Pilot Helmet displays custom HUD graphics, telemetry, and camera streams on your screen.
Right-click the Main Computer with the Pilot Helmet in hand to link them together.
Wear the linked helmet in your head armor slot. The computer will stream HUD overlay shapes, lines, text, and camera feeds directly to your screen!
